Avoid this service! Dishonest and incompetent.

I contacted them for my 2 year old Panasonic AC that stopped cooling. From the start the owner was avoiding to disclose the pricing over the phone and was only interested in getting my address.

He sent a technician named Azeem who performed an "inspection" without providing any upfront costs. Azeem claimed the gas was low and quoted Rs. 2500 for a refill, but couldn't explain why a new AC would lose gas or even give me a clear reading of the current gas levels. When I asked about a service coverage under Rs. 2500, he said no, this is only for one time service.

He demanded Rs. 250 as "visiting fee" i payed just to get him to leave.

A day later I called the authorized technicians. It turns out the gas levels were perfectly fine, the actual issue was a faulty PCB (which was covered under warranty).

Had I listened to these guys, I would have paid Rs. 2500 for a "repair" that wasn't needed or had any future coverage.

Warning to Mahim residents: Don’t be fooled by their ratings. They are looking for easy money and have no technical knowledge. Always ask for prices upfront and if you still decide to pay them do get a second opinion before wasting your money.
